instruction: Before create_app_base, choose exact component names for the current capability and pass components in usage priority order. Dependencies and Shell internals are automatic; omit future capabilities. Names and summaries are selection evidence, not API contracts. Use the returned UsageGuides after installation; read only missing API guides needed now.

components.name: YlButton
components.summary: Action button with disabled/loading guard; default slot; click event.

components.name: YlInput
components.summary: Native text input with string v-model, IME, readonly/disabled/invalid states.

components.name: YlTable
components.summary: Source table with selection, striped rows, cell/action slots, toolbar and pagination composition; controlled sorting and centered load/empty/error states.

components.name: YlPagination
components.summary: Basic, total count, page-size chooser, validated jump and simple modes; bounded controlled pages and disabled controls.

components.name: YlDialog
components.summary: Controlled native modal dialog with Escape, focus return, busy guard and footer slot.

components.name: YlListPage
components.summary: Page composition: title, description, actions/filters/default/pagination slots. No navigation or data.

components.name: YlShell
components.summary: Responsive workspace Shell with flat/grouped or recursive navigation children, accessible disclosure, active ancestors and mobile navigation.

components.name: YlSelect
components.summary: Single/multiple, four sizes, native-like states, grouped/empty/search panels, removable and overflow tags, clear and inset labels; controlled typed values.

components.name: YlIcon
components.summary: Reactive Lucide SVG; kebab-case name, numeric size. Bundled common icons; App Base loader for others.

components.name: YlPopover
components.summary: Controlled anchored non-modal panel with trigger slot, outside/Tab/Escape dismissal; use for account and notifications.

components.name: YlConfirmDialog
components.summary: Controlled confirmation modal with busy guard. Confirm before publishing/unpublishing or deleting; caller owns async mutation.

components.name: YlMessage
components.summary: Success/warning/error/info/loading; controlled top-center message, timeout/pause/dismissal. Loading persists until replaced or cleared.

components.name: YlCheckbox
components.summary: Boolean v-model; default slot labels the native checkbox. indeterminate is visual/mixed state; caller owns checkbox groups.

components.name: YlSwitch
components.summary: Default 20px and small 16px sizes, checked/unchecked, disabled and loading guards.

components.name: YlForm
components.summary: Native form with submit prevention and busy guard. Default slot; native validation works for native inputs. Caller validates custom controls and owns async requests.

components.name: YlFormItem
components.summary: Default scoped slot receives id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and required: bind them to the input. Set invalid on YlInput/YlSelect when error is present. No automatic schema validator.

components.name: YlStatusTag
components.summary: Text/fill/outline variants for success/warning/processing/stop/error/loading/waiting; visible labels and reduced-motion loading.

components.name: YlAlert
components.summary: Four semantic types, optional description, controlled dismissal and full-width banner. Use Message for transient mutation feedback.

components.name: YlBadge
components.summary: Three sizes, dot, count, overflow count, muted and five icon states, standalone or target/Avatar composition.

components.name: YlAvatar
components.summary: Four sizes and seven colors, bordered icons, person/department combinations, capsule, subtitle and guarded editing; image-error fallback.

components.name: YlProgress
components.summary: Linear default/large/small/mini sizes and normal/success/warning/error states; accessible clamped percentage, mini without visible text.

components.name: YlDescriptions
components.summary: Stacked, label-left, label-right, inline and inline-colon layouts; per-item slots and narrow-screen stacking.

components.name: YlBreadcrumb
components.summary: Default/large sizes, ellipsis expansion, disabled/current items and controlled navigation; modified links stay native.

components.name: YlDrawer
components.summary: Right-side native modal drawer with source widths 480/600/720/1080px, viewport bounds, body/footer slots and busy guards.

components.name: YlTabs
components.summary: Line/card/capsule/button/segmented/vertical variants, sizes, icons/counts/badges, scroll/add/extra controls and optional bordered content panels.

components.name: YlTooltip
components.summary: Top/bottom/left/right, opposite-side flip and viewport clamp, hover/focus/Escape with top-layer support.

components.name: YlTextarea
components.summary: String v-model with IME guard. Native rows, maxlength, required and label attributes. Resize vertically; caller owns validation.

components.name: YlInputNumber
components.summary: Number|null v-model; native number control. min/max/step use native constraint validation, never silently clamp typed values. Empty emits null; bad intermediate input emits nothing. Validate custom API submissions.

components.name: YlRadioGroup
components.summary: options: Array<{value:string|number,label:string,disabled?:boolean}>. Native radio group with legend and browser keyboard navigation. Value types are preserved. Source radio styling is in the original Form section, outside the source component index.

components.name: YlLayout
components.summary: Composable horizontal/vertical container; flow, parent-fill or viewport sizing.

components.name: YlHeader
components.summary: Optional header region with content-driven or explicit height.

components.name: YlAside
components.summary: Optional left or right region with explicit width and independent overflow; no menu coupling.

components.name: YlMain
components.summary: Flexible main/content region; optional independent scrolling and semantic tag.

components.name: YlFooter
components.summary: Optional footer region with content-driven or explicit height.

components.name: YlDatePicker
components.summary: Native date, month and local datetime input with explicit string values.

components.name: YlDateRangePicker
components.summary: Two native date controls with visible reversed-range validation.

components.name: YlUpload
components.summary: File selection, raster image preview and cancellable caller-provided upload requests.

components.name: YlAnchor
components.summary: Three-level section navigation, container-aware scroll and active tracking; ordinary clicks preserve App hash routing.

components.name: YlCascader
components.summary: Single and multiple leaf paths, local full-path search, groups/icons, disabled subtrees, parent checkbox selection and column keyboard navigation.

components.name: YlPopconfirm
components.summary: Anchored default/icon/description and simple confirmation; controlled success/failure and busy dismissal guards.

components.name: YlSegmentedPicker
components.summary: Four source sizes, controlled primitive values, disabled items and radio-group keyboard navigation.

components.name: YlSlider
components.summary: Default/small native single-value and dual-handle ranges; bounds, step, disabled and non-crossing updates.

components.name: YlSteps
components.summary: Horizontal/vertical ordered steps with or without descriptions; completed/active/pending/disabled/error states and parent-owned progress.

components.name: YlTimePicker
components.summary: Single/range local time strings, default/large/small, seconds, placeholders and disabled/readonly/error states; native panel, parent validates range order.

components.name: YlCheckboxGroup
components.summary: Controlled horizontal/vertical checkbox groups.

components.name: YlButtonGroup
components.summary: Source joined-button composition.

components.name: YlSplitButton
components.summary: Primary action with a separate dropdown trigger.

components.name: YlFormGroup
components.summary: Labeled fieldsets with one/two-column form layouts.

components.name: YlDropdown
components.summary: Single/multiple hierarchical menu selection with groups, search, icons and descriptions.

components.name: YlPageHeader
components.summary: Configurable breadcrumbs, title/status, actions and card tabs.

components.name: YlSidenav
components.summary: Standalone grouped/tree navigation with optional icon rail.

components.name: YlTopNav
components.summary: Light/dark header, optional product tabs, secondary navigation, links/search/actions; business owns navigation and optional menu trigger.

components.name: YlSkeleton
components.summary: Loading placeholder with bounded rows, optional title, reduced-motion animation and loaded-content slot.
